title: QuietLink idempotency record (schema_version 1)
description: Write-once record, one file per Idempotency-Key, published with link() so that only the first writer wins (spec §9.4, §9.4.1). Contains neither the raw Idempotency-Key, plaintext nor the raw deletion token. Encodings are Proposed (non-normative); see docs/storage-format.md.

schema_version.description: Storage format version of this file. Readers fail closed on any other value (ADR-0002).

key_hash.description: Hash of the Idempotency-Key (never the raw key). Also determines the file name.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the request body (32 bytes, base64url without padding).

paste_id.description: Identifier assigned to the paste created by the first request.

expires_at.description: expires_at of the created paste (Unix seconds), or null for a never-expiring paste.

retain_until.description: Retention deadline of this record (Unix seconds), bounded by idempotency_max_ttl (default 24h, 1h..7d) independently of the paste expiry.
